# Python project instructions

Python files (`.py`) may be accompanied by Markdown (`.md`), JSON (`.json`), TOML (`.toml`), YAML (`.yaml` or `.yml`), and Rust (`.rs`) files.
Use `*.py` when documenting a glob rather than a concrete file.
A neighboring concrete reference, `docs/missing.md`, must still be validated.
The phrase `Never apologize` is a quoted example.
